## Installation

You can install the development version of cdhexmap from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
remotes::install_github("kuriwaki/cdhexmap")
```

## Example


```{r example}
library(cdhexmap)

```

```{r}
c2009_shp
```

```{r geomsf}
c2009_shp |> 
  ggplot() + geom_sf(fill = "white") + theme_void() +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = district, geometry = center), size = 1)
```
